syllabus.session_label: NMC / NTA Official NEET (UG) Syllabus (Physics, Chemistry & Biology)
syllabus.overview: The NEET (UG) syllabus is finalized by the Under Graduate Medical Education Board (UGMEB) of the National Medical Commission (NMC) and published on neet.nta.nic.in. Both official syllabus PDFs hosted on neet.nta.nic.in are linked below.

primary_pdfs.title: NMC UGMEB Updated Syllabus for NEET (UG) – 2026 (Circular dated 22-12-2025)
NTA Portal Syllabus Document for NEET (UG) (Physics, Chemistry, Biology)

subjects.name: Physics (Units 1–20)
units: Unit 7: Properties of Solids and Liquids
Unit 13: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism
Unit 14: Electromagnetic Induction and Alternating Currents
Unit 17: Dual Nature of Matter and Radiation

subjects.name: Chemistry (Units 1–20)
units: Physical Chemistry (Units 1–8): Some Basic Concepts in Chemistry, Atomic Structure, Chemical Bonding & Molecular Structure, Chemical Thermodynamics, Solutions, Equilibrium, Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics
Inorganic Chemistry (Units 9–12): Classification of Elements & Periodicity in Properties, p-Block Elements, d- and f-Block Elements, Co-ordination Compounds

Organic Chemistry (Units 13–20): Purification & Characterisation of Organic Compounds, Some Basic Principles of Organic Chemistry, Hydrocarbons, Organic Compounds Containing Halogens, Organic Compounds Containing Oxygen, Organic Compounds Containing Nitrogen, Biomolecules, Principles Related to Practical Chemistry

subjects.name: Biology — Botany & Zoology (Units 1–10)
units: Unit 2: Structural Organisation in Animals and Plants

exam_pattern.overview: NEET (UG) is conducted in a single shift in offline Pen & Paper (OMR) mode with 180 compulsory Multiple Choice Questions (no optional Section B questions), carrying 720 maximum marks over 3 hours.

papers.duration: 3 Hours (180 Minutes: 02:00 PM – 05:00 PM IST) | PwBD Compensatory Time: +1 Hour (02:00 PM – 06:00 PM IST)

marking_scheme.rule: Incorrect Answer (or more than one oval darkened)

mediums: Urdu (13 Languages total; English prevails in case of ambiguity)
tie_breaking: 1. Higher marks/percentile score in Biology (Botany & Zoology)
4. Less proportion of attempted incorrect answers and correct answers in all subjects
5. Less proportion of attempted incorrect answers and correct answers in Biology (Botany & Zoology)
6. Less proportion of attempted incorrect answers and correct answers in Chemistry
7. Less proportion of attempted incorrect answers and correct answers in Physics
8. If tie still persists after criteria (a)–(g), resolved through a random process under the guidance of an independent expert committee (NMC UGMEB rule)

eligibility.age_limit: Minimum Age: Candidate must have completed 17 years of age at the time of admission or will complete that age on or before 31st December of the year of admission to the first year of the Undergraduate Medical Course. Upper Age Limit: No upper age limit for appearing in NEET (UG) per NMC letter U-11022/2/2022-UGMEB.
eligibility.attempt_limit: No restriction on the number of attempts in NEET (UG).
eligibility.qualifying_exam: Passed 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English individually (or appearing in Class 12). Candidates who passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and subsequently passed Biology/Biotechnology as an additional subject from a recognized board are also eligible per NMC Public Notice dated 22.11.2023.

qualifying_codes.description: Candidates appearing in the Class 12 / qualifying examination in the current year whose result is awaited.
Higher/Senior Secondary Examination or Indian School Certificate Examination (10+2) after 12 years of study with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English.
Intermediate / Pre-Degree Examination in Science of an Indian University/Board with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology (including practical tests) and English.
Pre-professional / Pre-medical Examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English after passing Higher Secondary or Pre-University.
First year of the three-year degree course of a recognized University with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Biotechnology including practical tests.
B.Sc. Examination of an Indian University with not less than two of Physics, Chemistry, Biology (Botany/Zoology)/Biotechnology, having passed earlier qualifying exam with PCB & English.
Any other examination found equivalent to Intermediate Science Examination of an Indian University/Board (including foreign qualifications verified by AIU).

counselling.overview: NTA conducts only the NEET (UG) examination and declares the All India Rank. Seat allocation and admissions are conducted separately by MCC (DGHS, MoH&FW), AACCC (Ministry of Ayush), and respective State/UT Counselling Authorities.
